Markets.title: Sebi’s CAS guidelines likely within a week, says chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey
Markets.summary: Sebi expects to issue guidelines on the derivatives settlement-price mechanism within a week following a review of the Closing Auction Session. The regulator is also working on simpler rules, easier market access, lower compliance costs, and stronger technological resilience.

Markets.title: Industrial, warehousing space leasing hits record 59.1 mn sq ft in top 24 cities in Jan-Sep: Savills
Markets.summary: Leasing of industrial and warehousing spaces in India's top 24 cities reached a record 59.1 million square feet between January and September, driven by demand from e-commerce, light manufacturing, and third-party logistics sectors. During the same period, fresh supply increased to 68.9 million square feet, with Tier-I cities accounting for 47.2 million square feet of the total leased space.

Markets.title: BPTP sells 150 apartments in its new housing project at Faridabad
Markets.summary: Real estate developer BPTP Ltd sold 150 luxury apartments in its Faridabad housing project, SkyNest, generating Rs 150 crore in revenue. The entire SkyNest project has now accumulated about Rs 750 crore in total sales.

Markets.title: Adani Green Energy H1 Update: Operational capacity rises 24% YoY to 20,763 MW, energy sales jump 32%
Markets.summary: Adani Green Energy reported a 24% year-on-year increase in operational capacity to 20,763 MW for H1FY27, alongside a 32% jump in energy sales to 25,747 million units. The company's board is scheduled to review its Q2FY27 financial results on October 21.

Markets.title: DMart Q2 Results: Cons profit rises nearly 9% YoY to Rs 743 crore, revenue jumps 18%
Markets.summary: Avenue Supermarts reported an 8.5% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 743 crore for Q2FY27, alongside an 17.8% jump in revenue to Rs 19,644 crore. Despite opening 15 new stores to reach a total of 518, the company experienced a decline in EBITDA and profit after tax margins due to entry-level wage inflation.

Markets.title: Bitcoin reclaims $82,500 as improved ETF flows lift market sentiment. Here is what experts say
Markets.summary: Bitcoin climbed back to $82,500 on Saturday following a nearly three-week low, driven by stronger exchange-traded fund inflows. Despite this recovery, experts warned that institutional outflows, geopolitical tensions, and security concerns continue to pose market risks.

Geo-Political.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
Geo-Political.summary: Former US President Donald Trump stated that Ukraine needs a new leader after President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized a Russian diesel deal supplying the US. Zelensky argued that the transaction helps Moscow finance its ongoing war against Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Twelve killed in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
Geo-Political.summary: Twelve people were killed and 309 others injured in an attack on the airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Saudi-led coalition blamed Yemen's Houthi movement for the strike and labeled it a war crime.

Geo-Political.title: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
Geo-Political.summary: Myanmar's struggling military junta is violently abducting young men from the streets to replenish its forces. These conscripts are forced to fight against ethnic militias and civilian resistance groups in an ongoing civil war.

Geo-Political.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 20 people, including children. President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the strike occurred in response to a U.S. diesel deal.

Geo-Political.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike, a convicted US murderer, was discharged from the hospital ten days after surviving two failed lethal injection attempts. Her lawyers stated that she is grateful to the medical team that cared for her.

Geo-Political.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
Geo-Political.summary: Hurricane Isaias struck the United States on Friday evening, causing four deaths and leaving thousands of people without power. The storm ripped roofs off buildings before weakening into a post-tropical cyclone.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization.

Data & Insights.title: Economic think tank says govt should withdraw proposed UPI charges. Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: GTRI urged the government to withdraw a proposed 0.4% fee on UPI merchant transactions above ₹2,000. The think tank warned that the charge would raise prices, squeeze small businesses, and weaken demand.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 75-100 bps in current cycle as inflation persists- SBI Capital flags December hike risk
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Capital warns that the Reserve Bank of India may raise the repo rate by 75 to 100 basis points during the current cycle due to persistent inflation. A larger-than-usual rate hike remains a possibility for December 2026.

Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation uses easy-to-read charts to provide data-based insights into recent news stories reported by Mint. The topics covered include rate hikes, SIP flows, and Airtel's tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: CEA bats for a review of loan overdue rules for MSMEs
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has recommended adjusting MSME loan overdue rules to match their actual cash-flow cycles. He argued that regulations should replace rigid global standards with customized approaches for small businesses.

India.title: 'CJP Is Their B-Team': Rekha Gupta's Dig At Rahul Gandhi, Arvind Kejriwal
India.summary: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta accused Rahul Gandhi and Arvind Kejriwal of attempting to turn the national capital into a political battleground. She also criticized them by calling CJP their "B-team."

India.title: "Unwarranted Interference": India Slams UN's Remarks On Delhi Detentions
India.summary: India criticized the UN Human Rights Office for expressing concern over recent detentions in Delhi, calling the remarks unwarranted interference. New Delhi stated that the UN body's concerns were misplaced and urged it to focus on large-scale protests in other regions instead.

India.title: All 3,000 Detainees Released, Except Abhijeet Dipke, Dhruv Rathee, 2 Others
India.summary: Authorities detained CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, Dhruv Rathee, and two others along with 3,000 other protesters in Delhi. While the other detainees have been released, Dipke, Rathee, and the two others remain in custody.

India.title: Delhi CJP Protest News Highlights: Delhi Metro Gates Reopened, Internet Services Restored Around Jantar Mantar
India.summary: Internet services and Delhi Metro gates have been reopened around Jantar Mantar following protests. Previously, entry and exit gates at 45 Delhi Metro stations, including Rajiv Chowk and New Delhi, had been closed due to the demonstrations.

India.title: "No Backing Down": INDIA Bloc To Hold Mega Protest Against Gyanesh Kumar Tomorrow
India.summary: Senior leaders of the INDIA opposition bloc plan to hold a major protest tomorrow against Gyanesh Kumar. The delegation will also submit a memorandum to the Chief Justice of India to request his intervention.

General.summary: An attack on the airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, by Yemen's Houthi movement has left 12 people dead and 309 injured. The Saudi-led coalition has condemned the strike as a war crime.

General.summary: King Charles warned about evolving tactics from malicious online actors in a letter for the National Cyber Security Centre's 10th anniversary. He also highlighted growing threats to the international order.

General.title: Bid to overturn ruling which stops police being sued for failings
General.summary: MPs are attempting to overturn a ruling that currently protects police from being sued for negligence, dishonesty, or fabricating evidence. The proposed change aims to remove this immunity and hold law enforcement legally accountable for such failings.
